title: Activation Rate Tracker: Data Pipeline (Etl)
description: Activation Rate Tracker built as a Data pipeline (ETL). Activation rate is the share of new signups that reach the product's key first value moment, like sending a first invoice or inviting a teammate. It is the bridge between acquisition and retention: users who never activate cannot become retained. Defining activation crisply is half the work; the rest is removing friction on the path to it. Extracts synthetic topic records, transforms them (drop invalid, normalize, bucket), and loads the clean set to CSV.

title: Process Bottleneck Finder: Command-Line Tool
description: Process Bottleneck Finder built as a Command-line tool. A bottleneck is the step with the lowest throughput: it sets the pace of the whole process no matter how fast everything else runs. Utilization near 100 percent with growing queues marks it. The finder computes capacity per step from cycle times and resources, then ranks constraints. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.

title: CAC Payback Period Model: Financial_Model
description: CAC Payback Period Model built as a financial_model. title: DCF Valuation Model: Financial_Model
description: DCF Valuation Model built as a financial_model. A discounted cash flow model projects free cash flow for several years, discounts each year at the weighted average cost of capital, and adds a terminal value for everything beyond the forecast. The terminal value often dominates, which is why growth and discount assumptions deserve the most scrutiny. Done well, DCF anchors valuation in fundamentals instead of market mood. A financial modeler computing NPV, IRR by bisection, DCF valuation, break-even point, and a loan amortization schedule from seeded synthetic inputs.
resume_bullet: Built a DCF Valuation Model in Python implementing NPV, bisection-based IRR, DCF valuation, break-even, and amortization math.

Attribution assigns credit for a conversion across the touches a buyer saw: first touch, last touch, linear, or position-based. No model is true, but comparing models shows which channels assist versus close. The honest use is directional budget shifts, not claiming exact ROI per touch. Draws a seeded synthetic sample and reports count, mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and an ASCII histogram.
resume_bullet: Built a Marketing Attribution Model statistical analyzer in pure Python computing mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and histograms from seeded synthetic data; prints a formatted report with an ASCII distribution plot.

title: Merger Accretion Dilution Simulator: Financial_Model
description: Merger Accretion Dilution Simulator built as a financial_model. A merger is accretive when the combined earnings per share rise after the deal and dilutive when they fall. The model combines the two income statements, adds synergies, subtracts financing costs and new shares, and compares pro-forma EPS to standalone EPS. Accretion math decides whether a deal creates or destroys shareholder value on paper. A financial modeler computing NPV, IRR by bisection, DCF valuation, break-even point, and a loan amortization schedule from seeded synthetic inputs.
resume_bullet: Built a Merger Accretion Dilution Simulator in Python implementing NPV, bisection-based IRR, DCF valuation, break-even, and amortization math.

title: Monte Carlo Revenue Simulator: Financial_Model
description: Monte Carlo Revenue Simulator built as a financial_model. Revenue never lands exactly on plan, so a Monte Carlo model draws thousands of possible futures from distributions for price, volume, and churn. The result is a probability distribution of revenue, not a single number, with percentiles a planner can actually commit to. It replaces false precision with honest ranges. A financial modeler computing NPV, IRR by bisection, DCF valuation, break-even point, and a loan amortization schedule from seeded synthetic inputs.
resume_bullet: Built a Monte Carlo Revenue Simulator in Python implementing NPV, bisection-based IRR, DCF valuation, break-even, and amortization math.

It is expensive in effort but exposes legacy spending nobody would approve fresh. The tool structures the justification workflow: decision packages, rankings, and cutoff lines. A financial modeler computing NPV, IRR by bisection, DCF valuation, break-even point, and a loan amortization schedule from seeded synthetic inputs.
resume_bullet: Built a Zero-Based Budgeting Tool in Python implementing NPV, bisection-based IRR, DCF valuation, break-even, and amortization math.
